title: Armed Man Shot by Deputy Responding to Active Shooter Call
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Douglas County, Colorado — On February 8th, 2025, Douglas County Deputies responded to an active shooter call at Main Event located at 64 Centennial Boulevard in Highlands Ranch, Colorado. A fight had broken out inside the women's restroom and ended with a shooting inside the business. During the investigation, detectives determined that, 23-year-old Jalin Seabron was involved as a step-sibling and accessory to the female suspect, who is alleged to have fired multiple shots inside the business following a physical altercation in the women's restroom. One victim was critically injured by gunfire during the initial shooting, causing widespread panic as customers fled the business.

The situation spilled into the parking lot, where Seabron was seen leaving the scene with the female suspect while armed with a handgun with an extended magazine. The dash camera, body camera, and exterior surveillance camera footage shows Seabron pointing his weapon at several individuals. Despite numerous commands to drop his weapon, Seabron failed to comply and turned toward the deputy, who faced with an immediate threat to his own life and the safety of those in the crowded parking lot discharged several rounds, striking him numerous times. Seabron succumbed to his injuries. investigators located his gun and through the course of the investigation located two other firearms.
